title: Hours Added Back While Adjusting to a New Pressure — PAP Therapy Equipment
content:
# Hours Added Back While Adjusting to a New Pressure — PAP Therapy Equipment

**Clinical note.** A pressure change shortens nights while the patient adjusts, and the average daily use stated on a PAP Therapy Equipment usage summary allows for it:

- a record with an **approved** pressure change request adds **0.3 hours**;
- a record whose pressure change request is **still submitted** adds **0.1 hours**;
- any other record adds nothing.

The hours are added to the average as it stands, before the stated figure is rounded.

**Where it is read.** From the requests on the device record whose type is a pressure change, by their status. An approved request decides whenever one is on the record.

| Pressure change requests on the record | Hours added |
|---|---|
| at least one approved | 0.3 |
| none approved, at least one submitted | 0.1 |
| none approved and none submitted (or no such request) | 0.0 |

**Case (hypothetical).** An approved request on a record averaging 3.7 hours: 3.7 plus 0.3 is 4.0 before rounding.
